description: Search the OpenTrain vetted talent pool. With q, ranks by hybrid semantic + lexical relevance (natural-language queries like "medical imaging annotator who speaks Spanish" work well); without q, facet-browses ranked by portable reputation. Facets: skill, language, country (name/alpha-2/alpha-3 all normalize — USA/US, Canada/CA, United Kingdom/GB/GBR, Australia/AU), badge (VERIFIED_TRAINER), talentType, availability, minReputation (0-100), confidenceTier, minHourlyRate/maxHourlyRate USD bounds, and inclusive memberSinceFrom/memberSinceTo ISO bounds on the canonical membership timestamp. sort=recent is a DETERMINISTIC full-discoverable-pool census ordered memberSince DESC, id ASC (independent of vector relevance): page it with cursor (from nextCursor) — cursor requires sort=recent and is mutually exclusive with offset. Responses carry truthful nextCursor/complete/total. Returns privacy-safe aggregate talent cards (masked name, no contact details, no per-buyer breakdowns); candidate-authored card text is sanitized at response time with explicit [REDACTED_*] placeholders plus per-card redactions provenance. Contact-shaped strings in q are neutralized before ranking, and a query consisting only of contact data returns an intentional empty result (never a facet-browse fallback). Requires talent:read scope.

available.description: now = only talent with no current assignment load (live capacity).

country.description: Country name, alpha-2, or alpha-3 (USA/US, Canada/CA, GB/GBR, AU all normalize).

cursor.description: Opaque continuation from a previous sort=recent page (nextCursor).

memberSinceFrom.description: Inclusive ISO-8601 lower bound on the canonical membership timestamp.

memberSinceTo.description: Inclusive ISO-8601 upper bound on the canonical membership timestamp.

sort.description: recent = deterministic full-pool census ordered memberSince DESC, id ASC (independent of vector relevance); page it with cursor, never offset.

name: opentrain_search_talent
